## Workstations For Gaming, AI, & Deep Learning

Optimized, Tested, & Ready to Run

Discover custom-built computers engineered for extreme performance. Power you can feel, and results you can see. Optimized for AAA Games, PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and CUDA.  

Train AI Models

Run LLMs

Handle Multi-GPU Workloads

Trusted by leading brands


Canada's Best

## **Built Locally In Toronto, Trusted Nationwide**

15+ Years Experience, Expertly Hand-Crafted

Alpha PC builds high‑performance workstations for professionals in Toronto. Our expert builder hand‑crafts each system using components optimized for resource‑intensive tasks, including:

Gaming

3D Rendering

High‑Frequency Trading & More

Trusted by 2000+ customers

## **Get a Workstation That Matches Your Workload.**

Specify how you plan to use the system and any key software or applications you’ll be running.

*   Dillon was a pleasure to deal with. He went above and beyond the call of duty in building my custom PC. His knowledge and expertise is thorough and hands down i call him the king when it comes to building a custom crazy liquid cooled pc in the GTA. I was blown away at the final product! If your looking for a custom pc, he's the guy to go to! Thanks once again Dillon! Cheers!
    
*   I got a pc a few months ago and I have to say is one of the best things I could've bought, great job by the guys from Alpha PC same as good customer service. Also Dillon was very helpful and kept me informed about the pc's building process at any time. Keep up the good work.  
    
*   They built me a beast of a system. One of the more simple shopping experiences I've had. Dillon always replied quickly to any questions, and upgraded my build at no charge to be more compatible with my specific needs which is highly appreciated. I am very happy with my investment, specially in a time where parts are very difficult to get a hold of. I'm a videographer and this new system will make my workflow seems like child's play! Alpha PC went above and beyond for me! Thanks
    
*   For anyone looking to build a PC, I have personally had him build me 3 different PC for my business and customer service is unmatchable. They love what they do and have a passion to make each and every one of there clients happy. Perfect service and perfect knowledge. 🔥
